question: Which materials are listed as suitable for the vessels?
premises: Clay is named as a material.
Tortoise-derived and bell-metal materials are named.
Copper or metal is also named.
inference: Vessels may be made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell-metal, or copper.
uncertainties: kūrmajaṃ may refer to a tortoise-shell vessel.
plain_english: O goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell-metal, or made of copper.
